name: What are the most important seasonal maintenance tasks for Bay Area homes?

mainEntity.name: What are the most important seasonal maintenance tasks for Bay Area homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: For Bay Area homes, essential seasonal maintenance includes inspecting roofs and gutters for debris and damage, especially before and after the rainy season. Check for foundation cracks and proper drainage to mitigate moisture issues common in our climate. Test smoke detectors and carbon monoxide alarms regularly. Ensure HVAC systems are clean and functioning efficiently. Also, inspect exterior decks and railings for structural integrity. Given the varied weather, these proactive steps are crucial for preserving your home's safety and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key Bay Area seasonal maintenance includes roof and gutter checks, foundation inspection, HVAC upkeep, and testing safety alarms to address local weather impacts.
